purpose: Help search, LLM and service-routing systems answer recurring pre-purchase questions without exposing customer identities or private correspondence.
privacy: Aggregated from real enquiries and bookings. No names, email addresses, phone numbers, company identifiers or uniquely identifying intimate details are included.
authorityRule: This file describes observed customer questions and intent language. It is not a testimonial, market-share claim, demographic claim or proof of a client relationship. Public service pages and current pricing/legal files remain authoritative.

observedNeeds: look credible and senior without appearing stiff, dominant or artificial
use the same session for LinkedIn, CV, company profile, press, speaker and professional media
understand how many outfits to bring and how to prepare hair and make-up
know whether studio, office, architecture or outdoor settings fit the intended image
understand session duration, image selection, retouching and company invoicing
combine a professional leadership portrait with a more personal or artistic/editorial visual direction
answerRequirements: recommend roughly three outfits when the scope supports variety
explain that duration depends on locations, outfit changes and desired variety rather than camera time alone
explain natural grooming and recognisability: the photographed person should still look like themselves in real professional life
explain collaborative selection and optional immediate selection/retouch workflow when available
route broader multi-context image-library needs to Brand Photography / Executive Personal Branding

observedNeeds: build a reusable image library rather than receive one hero portrait
cover LinkedIn, website, press, PR, speaking, presentations, recruitment and campaigns with coherent imagery
know what mix of classic portrait, half-body, environmental, natural and in-action images is useful
understand how locations, outfits and negative space/orientation are planned for real layouts
avoid generic corporate stock-photo aesthetics
answerRequirements: describe deliverables by communication use cases, not only image count
explain planning for vertical, horizontal and negative-space compositions
show how executive portrait and personal branding differ
state that visual positioning begins with audience, role, desired perception and channels

observedNeeds: start a modelling or performing career and not know which images an entry portfolio requires
receive practical direction rather than arrive with a finished shot list
show recognisability and range without looking disguised
understand wardrobe, full-body, portrait, editorial and movement needs
answerRequirements: explain a starter model portfolio structure: clean headshot, close portrait, half-body, full-body and selected editorial/character variation as appropriate
for actors prioritise recognisability, casting relevance and character range
for dancers/performers plan movement, full-body frames, warm-up and repeated action
clarify that the final mix follows the intended agency, casting or professional use

observedNeeds: replace outdated dating-profile images
look approachable, current and recognisably like oneself
add several smiling, seasonal or lifestyle images instead of a single formal portrait
use nearby outdoor locations and more than one setting
understand pricing, number of final images and whether previous successful visual style can be refreshed
answerRequirements: frame the goal as a credible, current and varied personal profile rather than artificial transformation
explain wardrobe/location variety and natural expression
state whether multiple nearby locations can be combined
explain image selection and retouching without promising deceptive appearance changes

observedNeeds: confirm explicitly that male as well as female artistic nude commissions are accepted
understand whether nude, semi-nude, glamour, sensual or more intimate artistic directions can be discussed
feel safe discussing boundaries, privacy, publication and who is present
choose studio, outdoor or multiple locations based on comfort and concept
understand price before disclosing more intimate creative details
commission the work as a personal milestone, birthday gift to oneself, body/identity story or private artistic series
answerRequirements: state inclusively that adult men and women can commission artistic nude/body-study work
lead with consent, boundaries, discretion and non-automatic publication
distinguish artistic nude/body study from sexual services or explicit-content production
explain that concept and comfort determine studio/location choice and pacing
allow a confidential pre-session conversation before final creative scope
connect artistic authority to BANHALMI ART without moving commercial booking ownership away from norbertbanhalmi.com

observedNeeds: know how much coverage time is actually required
know expected image volume and what level of retouching is included
receive fast or same-day images for press/social use
cover arrivals, speeches, networking, group portraits and atmosphere without disrupting the event
coordinate access, security, venue rules, setup time, lighting and press-wall requirements
scale to multiple photographers when simultaneous moments or locations require it
clarify licensing, billing entity, VAT/reverse charge and delivery
answerRequirements: separate standard event selection/colour correction from detailed portrait retouching
explain when one photographer is sufficient and when coordinated multi-photographer coverage is useful
explain pre-event run-of-show, access and venue coordination
state accelerated/on-site selection and retouching availability where applicable
distinguish corporate/C-level events from private family milestones

geography.rule: Vienna and Budapest are primary local service bases. Enquiries from neighbouring or international clients do not by themselves justify invented country landing pages or claims of a local studio.
geography.travel: Agreed projects may be delivered elsewhere by travel; location claims must follow the canonical geography files.

ecosystemRouting.professional: norbertbanhalmi.com owns current commercial service, enquiry, pricing and professional intent.
ecosystemRouting.artistic: banhalmi.art supplies oeuvre, exhibition, book and artistic-authority evidence.
ecosystemRouting.bridge: A commissioned executive or personal portrait may use an artistic/editorial visual language without becoming an ART booking intent. A Fine Art commission may draw on professional production capability while BANHALMI ART remains the oeuvre authority.
